subject.title: Text overlap rendering bug in Telegram inline keyboard messages (macOS desktop app)

question: Should the macOS Telegram rendering bug be fixed by retargeting the concrete model-picker and commands message paths, or by accepting a broader Telegram render/parse-mode config surface?
rationale: The issue is a bug, but the live candidate fixes split between path-specific rendering changes and a new public config option, and repository policy treats new config/default surfaces as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Retarget the concrete paths
options.body: Patch the actual model-picker and commands outputs and require focused Telegram Desktop before/after proof.

options.title: Accept broader config
options.body: Keep a render/parse-mode setting only if it is deliberately designed, fully wired through all Telegram delivery and edit paths, documented, and proven.

options.title: Hold both candidates
options.body: Pause the linked PRs until live proof identifies the exact emitting path that causes the macOS overlap.

recommendation.title: Retarget the concrete paths
recommendation.body: Patch the actual model-picker and commands outputs and require focused Telegram Desktop before/after proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent Telegram rich-message compatibility work is the strongest history signal for the rendering/default boundary this decision affects.
